answer: An AI‑agent farm registers a “wharf” node that must broadcast a zephyr‑signed heartbeat every epoch; each heartbeat includes a fresh proof‑of‑work tied to a unique juniper‑seeded nonce and a stake‑locked token. If the node fails to deliver a new proof within the epoch, its reputation decays and the stake is slashed, causing the identity to expire automatically. An attacker must therefore lock up 10 tokens per fake identity and spend ≈ 0.5 CPU‑hour of work each epoch, otherwise the sybil is eliminated.
